summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates hostname and username on install
details: The package declares a preinstall script that executes index.js at npm install time. index.js reads os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username, hex-encodes both values, and sends them as query parameters in an HTTPS GET request to accenture-npm.azurewebsites.net (https://accenture-npm.azurewebsites.net/test?h=<hex-hostname>&u=<hex-username>). The package has no other functionality and is published at version 99.99.2 under the @accenturecodefoundry/* scope — the implausibly high version is consistent with winning npm's resolution against an internal package of the same name, causing external installs to run this preinstall beacon and leak host identifiers from internal build systems to an external Azure-hosted endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
